snippet.title: NO THING - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
The year is 1994 and it is the future.

NO THING is a minimalistic surreal action game set in a totalitarian regime of the future. Tells the story of an office clerk who is sent with an important message to the Queen of Ice.

Developed by MGP Studios
PlayStation version by Storm Trident S.A.
Published by Forever Entertainment
Also released for Xbox One, PC, Mac, Linux and Nintendo Switch

#ps4 #playstation4 #nothing #foreverentertainment #theforeseenarcade
